related.title: Apache TVM MetaSchedule：調參成本與回本
related.titleEn: Apache TVM MetaSchedule: tuning cost and amortization
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：就緒相依和順序正確，尾端可重現，合併收益以完整步時間評估。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Readiness/order pass, tails reproduce, and aggregation is judged by full-step time.
related.difference: 把一次性編譯成本與每次執行節省分開，保留目標裝置及形狀的有效範圍。
related.differenceEn: Separate one-time tuning from per-run savings and retain target/shape validity.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 單通訊引擎的bucket開始=max(就緒,前bucket完成)，整步完成取最後計算與通訊完成最大值。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 三bucket就緒2、5、8 ms，每個通訊2 ms，計算於8 ms結束。 通訊區間[2,4]、[5,7]、[8,10]，整步10 ms，尾端2 ms。
回本次數N=Ctune/(told−tnew)，只有每次節省為正才有有限回本點。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 調參耗時600 s，原每次20 ms，新每次16 ms，工作形狀固定。 N=600/(0.020−0.016)=150000次；此後才抵銷調參時間。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: On one communication engine, start=max(readiness, previous finish); step completion is the last compute/communication finish. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Three buckets ready at 2, 5, 8 ms, each taking2 ms communication; compute ends at 8 ms. Communication intervals[2, 4],[5, 7],[8, 10] give10 ms completion and 2 ms tail.

Break-even runs N=Ctune/(told−tnew), finite only for positive per-run savings. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Tuning600 s, old20 ms/run, new16 ms/run, fixed shapes. N=150000 runs before tuning time is amortized.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: vLLM 連續批次：Little定律與入場控制
related.titleEn: vLLM continuous batching: Little law and admission
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：就緒相依和順序正確，尾端可重現，合併收益以完整步時間評估。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Readiness/order pass, tails reproduce, and aggregation is judged by full-step time.
related.difference: 使用同一系統邊界量測到達率與逗留時間，推導平均在系統請求數。
related.differenceEn: Measure arrival rate and residence time within one boundary to derive average requests in system.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 單通訊引擎的bucket開始=max(就緒,前bucket完成)，整步完成取最後計算與通訊完成最大值。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 三bucket就緒2、5、8 ms，每個通訊2 ms，計算於8 ms結束。 通訊區間[2,4]、[5,7]、[8,10]，整步10 ms，尾端2 ms。
穩定系統Little定律L=λW；W須包含邊界內等待與處理，不能混用只計算時間。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學λ12請求/s、平均W2.5 s，無長期積壓增長；請求長度分布固定。 平均在系統L=12×2.5=30請求，不等於硬體每一時刻的batch大小。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: On one communication engine, start=max(readiness, previous finish); step completion is the last compute/communication finish. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Three buckets ready at 2, 5, 8 ms, each taking2 ms communication; compute ends at 8 ms. Communication intervals[2, 4],[5, 7],[8, 10] give10 ms completion and 2 ms tail.

For a stable system, L=λW; W includes waiting and service within the chosen boundary. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teachingλ12 requests/s, W2.5 s, no growing backlog and fixed length distribution. AverageL30 requests, not instantaneous hardware batch size.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
